newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed - gas oil up on futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed - gas oil up on futures.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Monday, traders said.
Gasoline lost $1-2 a tonne in a thin market that was waiting for the U.S. open to give some direction.
Spot gas oil prices were slightly firmer in line with gains on benchmark gas oil futures, while barge and cargo differentials were stable in very quiet discussion.
High sulphur fuel oil barges traded a little higher at $86 then talk fell slightly to Friday's closing range of about $85.50 with low demand said to be sapping the market.
